{{Quote|I am Seetoo Enntoo, steward of this vessel. It is my extreme good fortune to serve you.|C2-N2|<ref name="TOR:IC" />}}
'''C2-N2''', also known as '''Seetoo Enntoo''', was a [[Hollis-series steward droid]] owned by [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Meteor]], [[Havoc Squad]]'s commanding [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. Assigned to Meteor's [[BT-7 Thunderclap]] as its steward in [[3643 BBY]], C2-N2 was responsible for maintaining the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and ensuring that the squad remained comfortable.
